notes.title: Ver1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
Ver1.0.3 - Significant Difficulty Reduction

Added a large number of lockers to maps beyond the first area.

Removed enemies from particularly difficult areas.

In Area 3, after completing tasks outside the F door area, you can now return to the door entrance more easily.

If you wish to revert to the previous difficulty, please switch to Ver1.0.2 from the properties of "シシテナオ -Even in Death-".
